heading: ## Mutation-sweep recipe — numbered steps; bounded cold-read evidence

findings.why: Step 10's shape list requires 'survivor probes' (SKILL.md:248), but the kimi half of the pointer omits the only section that holds them: the note's §2 'Surviving-defect class analysis' (corpus/knowledge/mutation-case-kimi-census.md:80-107) carries both non-equivalence probes (D2 at :90-91 — pristine `+22 more` vs mutant `+23 more`; D10 at :98-99 — `frozen=25` vs `frozen=24`), while §3 (:135-142) carries only the not-protected inventory, with no probe command or output. The kagi half of the same pointer is '§1-§7', which includes its §2 (the probe paragraph at :107-123), so the two halves disagree about whether the probe section is part of the model. Non-blocking: step 8 of the same section (SKILL.md:230-233) cites kimi:82-99, which lies inside §2, so a reader following the whole section does reach the probes. Fix shape: '§1-§6' for kimi, matching the kagi pointer. Receipt: .ufo/waves/round-55/w2/T55W3R04-receipts/findings.out (kimi heading list + probe lines + §3 excerpt).

findings.quote:
survivor probes, reproduce spec (driver manifest + commands), calibration
    and errata, unknowns
findings.why: The step tells the recorder to write a reproduce spec as 'driver manifest + commands' and names the two case notes as the model, but both notes' reproduce specs are on record as insufficient: the kagi note's Erratum R21 (corpus/knowledge/mutation-case-kagi-census.md:271-275) states that the old §7 commands depend on an unversioned scratch `mutate_driver.py` and 'do not by themselves recreate that driver after scratch loss', directing readers to `bash tools/mutate-and-run.sh --regression`; `## Restore discipline` item 6 (SKILL.md:411-415) says the same, and that route exists in the tree (tools/mutate-and-run.sh:139-143 documents the --regression exit map). The section names the maintained driver only for two implementation details (:434 at SKILL.md:189, :579-583 at SKILL.md:226) and contains no occurrence of 'regression', 'unversioned' or 'scratch loss' (0 lines), while its opening calls the recipe 'self-contained' (SKILL.md:149). A sweep recorded exactly per step 10 therefore reproduces the shape R21 records as non-rebuilding. Non-blocking: step 9 points the reader at `## Restore discipline`, whose item 6 carries both the caveat and the replay route. Receipt: .ufo/waves/round-55/w2/T55W3R04-receipts/findings.out (0-hit token scan, R21 lines, Restore item 6, --regression lines).
